stages.operation: Stream pages whose ns is exactly 0, model is wikitext, and redirect marker is absent; retain page ID, title, revision ID, timestamp, and exact revision text
stages.output: Exact UTF-8 wikitext bytes plus byte count and SHA-256
stages.loss_rule: Preserve the verified dump files and exact extracted wikitext; never overwrite either layer

stages.input: Frozen revision ID and dump wikitext
stages.operation: Call the English Wikipedia Action API parse endpoint with action=parse, format=json, formatversion=2, oldid={revision_id}, prop=text|wikitext|revid, disableeditsection=1, disabletoc=1, disablelimitreport=1, and maxlag=5; require returned pageid, revid, title, and wikitext SHA-256 to match the dump record
stages.output: Exact API response and rendered HTML bytes with retrieval time, byte counts, and SHA-256
stages.loss_rule: Cache the response and HTML because templates can expand using retrieval-time state; a later rerender is not an identity substitute

stages.operation: Reuse extract_blocks; retain nonempty p and h2-h6 blocks in document order, normalize runs of whitespace within each block to one ASCII space, exclude configured tables, lists, media, references, navigation, and page furniture, stop at a configured tail-section heading, and join plain blocks with two LF characters
stages.output: Ordered block records and exact extracted UTF-8 text with byte count and SHA-256
stages.loss_rule: Preserve response, HTML, block records, and extracted text as separate layers

stages.operation: Treat one frozen article revision as one document; assign s1, s2, ... to retained p blocks only, keep headings as context, and derive each block's zero-based half-open character and UTF-8 byte offsets from the exact two-LF join
stages.output: Stable paragraph segment IDs and offsets into exact extracted text
stages.loss_rule: Segments reference but never replace the exact extracted text

stages.operation: Reuse token_records and the metric contract; assign t1, t2, ... in document order and store surface, token-level normalized form, and zero-based half-open character and UTF-8 byte offsets
stages.output: Stable token records and token SHA-256
stages.loss_rule: No whole-text Unicode normalization; normalized tokens always retain surface and both offsets

identities.document: doc- plus the first 20 hexadecimal characters of SHA-256 over compact JSON [document-v1, enwiki:page:{page_id}:revision:{revision_id}]
identities.segment: s plus one-based retained-paragraph position, scoped by document ID
identities.token: t plus one-based token position, scoped by document ID
identities.source_trace: Every segment and token surface must equal both its character slice and decoded UTF-8 byte slice of the hashed extracted text

fail_closed: Reject acquisition unless local bytes, MD5, and SHA-1 match the frozen dump descriptor; record local SHA-256 before sampling.
Reject a document when page, revision, title, wikitext, rendered response, extracted text, segment, token, or offset identity differs.
Reject preprocessing if an original layer was discarded or an irreversible view cannot be traced to exact retained bytes.
Start a new contract version before changing extraction, segmentation, tokenization, normalization, or IDs after annotation begins.

current_boundary.verified_evidence: Project-authored synthetic HTML and text only
current_boundary.claim_ceiling: dated source metadata and preprocessing procedure frozen; no sampled documents, annotations, or benchmark availability
